items.title: Sixth powerful attack submarine departs Barrow-in-Furness for sea trials
items.summary: UK and Euro-Atlantic security will soon be boosted, as the Royal Navy’s sixth powerful attack submarine departs from Barrow-in-Furness.
items.body:
Latest Astute Class submarine, HMS Agamemnon has sailed from the BAE Systems shipyard in Barrow-in-Furness.

She will now undergo sea trials – a major step towards delivering the highly capable attack submarine to bolster security for the UK and the Euro-Atlantic.

The UK’s submarine industrial base is benefitting from £6 billion of Government investment over the Spending Review period and sustains thousands of jobs.

The newest Royal Navy conventionally armed nuclear-powered submarine, HMS Agamemnon and nicknamed ‘Awesome Aggie’, will now begin sea trials - a period of testing ahead of joining active service with the Royal Navy.

The Astute Class are the largest, most advanced and most powerful attack submarines ever operated by the Royal Navy. Weighing 7,400 tonnes and at 97 metres long, they are just short of the length of two Olympic swimming pools. Powered by a Rolls-Royce Submarines nuclear reactor, produced in Derby in the Midlands, the submarine will not need to refuel for the duration of her service life.

The submarine’s high-tech capabilities include stealthy precision strike, anti-submarine warfare, and intelligence gathering. HMS Agamemnon will be armed with heavyweight Spearfish torpedoes and Tomahawk IV land attack missiles, able to strike targets at a range of more than 1,000 miles.

Alongside their role supporting the continuous at sea deterrent, Astute-class submarines are also involved in protecting maritime task groups and providing support to UK, NATO and coalition operations.

Prime Minister Andy Burnham said:

Having seen first-hand the dedication and pride of the workforce in Barrow, and that of the thousands of people who work across our submarine supply chain in the United Kingdom, I know how much this milestone will mean to each and every one of them. As one of the most advanced submarines ever built, HMS Agamemnon will play a major role in further boosting our security here at home and across NATO.

Having seen first-hand the dedication and pride of the workforce in Barrow, and that of the thousands of people who work across our submarine supply chain in the United Kingdom, I know how much this milestone will mean to each and every one of them.

As one of the most advanced submarines ever built, HMS Agamemnon will play a major role in further boosting our security here at home and across NATO.

Defence Secretary, Wes Streeting MP said:

Deterrence is the bedrock of our national security. Another formidable attack submarine going to sea strengthens that deterrence and demonstrates how we are stepping up to meet the threats of a more dangerous world. I’ve been on board HMS Agamemnon and met her submariners and the skilled workers who delivered this incredible feat of engineering. It’s a powerful reminder of how strengthening our defence creates good jobs, opens up opportunity, and reindustrialises our country.

Deterrence is the bedrock of our national security. Another formidable attack submarine going to sea strengthens that deterrence and demonstrates how we are stepping up to meet the threats of a more dangerous world.

I’ve been on board HMS Agamemnon and met her submariners and the skilled workers who delivered this incredible feat of engineering. It’s a powerful reminder of how strengthening our defence creates good jobs, opens up opportunity, and reindustrialises our country.

HMS Agamemnon’s departure from Barrow-in-Furness is the result of years of work by a highly skilled workforce. This includes the engineers, technicians and specialists at BAE Systems and the Defence Nuclear Enterprise (DNE), together with the ship’s company who will take her into service. Their combined expertise reflects the depth of skill sustained in Barrow and across the UK’s submarine enterprise.

Maddy McTernan, Chief of Defence Nuclear, said:

HMS Agamemnon’s departure is a significant moment for the UK’s Defence Nuclear Enterprise and is a clear demonstration of the engineering and industrial excellence of the Barrow workforce and across the wider UK supply chain. Submarine production will continue to boost British industry for decades to come backed by the commitments announced in the recent Defence Investment Plan.

HMS Agamemnon’s departure is a significant moment for the UK’s Defence Nuclear Enterprise and is a clear demonstration of the engineering and industrial excellence of the Barrow workforce and across the wider UK supply chain.

Submarine production will continue to boost British industry for decades to come backed by the commitments announced in the recent Defence Investment Plan.

Royal Navy First Sea Lord, General Sir Gwyn Jenkins, said:

In an increasingly dangerous world, sea power remains fundamental to keeping our country and people safe. Our submarine fleet is essential to that effort, which is why I am delighted that HMS Agamemnon, the sixth of our Astute-class submarines, has now begun sea trials and will soon arrive at HMNB Clyde to join the fleet. She embodies the best of British engineering and the professionalism of our submariners and will be one of the most advanced submarines ever operated by the Royal Navy. As we continue to strengthen our warfighting readiness, HMS Agamemnon will play a central role in keeping the United Kingdom safe, contributing to NATO’s collective defence and ensuring we are ready to lead, fight and win.

In an increasingly dangerous world, sea power remains fundamental to keeping our country and people safe. Our submarine fleet is essential to that effort, which is why I am delighted that HMS Agamemnon, the sixth of our Astute-class submarines, has now begun sea trials and will soon arrive at HMNB Clyde to join the fleet.

She embodies the best of British engineering and the professionalism of our submariners and will be one of the most advanced submarines ever operated by the Royal Navy.

As we continue to strengthen our warfighting readiness, HMS Agamemnon will play a central role in keeping the United Kingdom safe, contributing to NATO’s collective defence and ensuring we are ready to lead, fight and win.

Building on commitments to continuous submarine production made in the 2025 Strategic Defence Review, and reinforced in the Defence Investment Plan (DIP), the completion of HMS Agamemnon demonstrates the strength and reliability of British industry and its world-leading nuclear technology.

The DIP is backed by £298 billion over the next four years, including £47 billion for investment in our submarine build programmes, which also covers maintenance and infrastructure. Part of that spend will enable the UK to produce a submarine every 18 months in support of the SSN-AUKUS programme.

Recognising Barrow’s role as a strategic national asset, DNE spending is fuelling substantial growth and expansion in the town. The economic certainty from the government’s commitment to the submarine building programme underpins the 10-year Plan for Barrow, backed by the £200 million Barrow Transformation Fund. More than 14,000 roles in Barrow-in-Furness are supported by defence nuclear work, with 1,800 additional roles created in Barrow under this government.

HMS Agamemnon has been delivered as part of a national endeavour by the MOD’s DNE, the partnership organisations that operate, maintain, renew and sustain the UK’s nuclear deterrent. The DNE supports over 47,000 jobs across the UK, including thousands of highly-skilled roles involved in submarine production.

Marking entry into the Royal Navy, HMS Agamemnon was formally commissioned by His Majesty the King in a ceremony on 22 September 2025. She is the sixth Navy vessel to bear the name.

The seventh and final submarine in the class, Achilles, is at an advanced stage of construction in Barrow. The Astute Class will be succeeded by up to 12 new SSN-AUKUS nuclear-powered attack submarines from the late 2030s, with steel due to be cut for the first-in-class in Barrow next year, continuing the town’s role at the heart of AUKUS delivery.
zhParas: 最新一艘机敏级潜艇 HMS Agamemnon 已从位于巴罗因弗内斯的 BAE Systems 造船厂驶出。
她现将接受海试——这是向交付这艘能力强大的攻击潜艇、以加强英国和欧洲-大西洋地区安全迈出的重要一步。
在支出审查期间，英国潜艇工业基础正受益于政府 £6 billion 投资，并维持数千个就业岗位。
英国皇家海军最新一艘常规武器核动力潜艇 HMS Agamemnon，绰号“Awesome Aggie”，现将开始海试——这是加入皇家海军现役前的一段测试期。
机敏级是英国皇家海军有史以来操作过的最大、最先进和最强力的攻击潜艇。它们重达 7,400 tonnes，长 97 metres，仅比两个奥林匹克游泳池的长度短一点。该潜艇由在英格兰中部德比生产的罗尔斯·罗伊斯潜艇核反应堆提供动力，在服役期内将无需更换核燃料。
该潜艇的高科技能力包括隐蔽精确打击、反潜战和情报收集。HMS Agamemnon 将配备重型 Spearfish 鱼雷和 Tomahawk IV 对陆攻击导弹，能够打击超过 1,000 miles 范围内的目标。
除了支持持续海上威慑任务外，机敏级潜艇还参与保护海上任务群，并为英国、北约和联军行动提供支持。
首相安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）表示：
亲眼目睹巴罗（Barrow）员工以及英国潜艇供应链数千名员工的奉献与自豪，我深知这一里程碑对他们每一个人将有多么重要。作为有史以来建造的最先进潜艇之一，HMS Agamemnon将在进一步加强我们本土及整个北约的安全方面发挥重要作用。

作为有史以来建造的最先进潜艇之一，HMS Agamemnon将在进一步加强我们本土及整个北约的安全方面发挥重要作用。
国防大臣、议员韦斯·斯特里廷（Wes Streeting）表示：
威慑是我们国家安全的基石。又一艘强大的攻击型潜艇出海，增强了这一威慑，并表明我们正在加大力度应对一个更加危险的世界所带来的威胁。我曾登上HMS Agamemnon，会见了该艇潜艇兵以及完成这一惊人工程壮举的技术工人。这有力提醒我们，加强国防如何创造优质就业、开拓机遇，并推动我国再工业化。

HMS Agamemnon驶离巴罗因弗内斯（Barrow-in-Furness），是一支技能高超的员工队伍多年努力的成果。这包括BAE Systems和国防核企业（Defence Nuclear Enterprise，DNE）的工程师、技术人员和专家，以及将接舰服役的全舰官兵。他们的综合专长反映了巴罗及英国潜艇产业所保持的技能深度。
国防核事务主管玛迪·麦克特南（Maddy McTernan）表示：
HMS Agamemnon的离港对英国国防核事业而言是一个重要时刻，也明确展示了巴罗员工队伍以及更广泛英国供应链的工程与工业卓越实力。在近期《国防投资计划》所宣布承诺的支持下，潜艇生产将在未来数十年继续提振英国工业。

她体现了英国工程技术的最高水平以及我们潜艇艇员的专业素养，并将成为皇家海军有史以来操作过的最先进潜艇之一。

2025年战略防务评估中作出的持续建造潜艇的承诺，在《防务投资计划》（DIP）中得到进一步强化；HMS Agamemnon 的完工表明，英国工业及其世界领先的核技术具备强大实力与可靠性。
《防务投资计划》在未来四年获得2980亿英镑支持，其中470亿英镑用于投资潜艇建造项目，也涵盖维护与基础设施。部分支出将使英国能够每18个月建造一艘潜艇，以支持 SSN-AUKUS 计划。
巴罗作为国家战略资产的地位得到认可，国防核企业（DNE）的支出正推动该镇大幅增长与扩张。政府对潜艇建造计划的承诺所带来的经济确定性，为巴罗十年计划提供支撑，该计划由2亿英镑的巴罗转型基金支持。巴罗因弗内斯有超过14000个岗位依靠国防核工作维持，本届政府执政期间在巴罗新增1800个岗位。

该级第七艘也是最后一艘潜艇“阿喀琉斯”号（Achilles）目前正在巴罗进行后期建造。自2030年代末起，机敏级将由此后最多12艘新型 SSN-AUKUS 核动力攻击潜艇接替，首艇将于明年在巴罗切割首块钢板，使该镇继续在奥库斯联盟交付工作中处于核心地位。

最新一艘机敏级潜艇 HMS Agamemnon 已从位于巴罗因弗内斯的 BAE Systems 造船厂驶出。

她现将接受海试——这是向交付这艘能力强大的攻击潜艇、以加强英国和欧洲-大西洋地区安全迈出的重要一步。

在支出审查期间，英国潜艇工业基础正受益于政府 £6 billion 投资，并维持数千个就业岗位。

英国皇家海军最新一艘常规武器核动力潜艇 HMS Agamemnon，绰号“Awesome Aggie”，现将开始海试——这是加入皇家海军现役前的一段测试期。

机敏级是英国皇家海军有史以来操作过的最大、最先进和最强力的攻击潜艇。它们重达 7,400 tonnes，长 97 metres，仅比两个奥林匹克游泳池的长度短一点。该潜艇由在英格兰中部德比生产的罗尔斯·罗伊斯潜艇核反应堆提供动力，在服役期内将无需更换核燃料。

该潜艇的高科技能力包括隐蔽精确打击、反潜战和情报收集。HMS Agamemnon 将配备重型 Spearfish 鱼雷和 Tomahawk IV 对陆攻击导弹，能够打击超过 1,000 miles 范围内的目标。

除了支持持续海上威慑任务外，机敏级潜艇还参与保护海上任务群，并为英国、北约和联军行动提供支持。

亲眼目睹巴罗（Barrow）员工以及英国潜艇供应链数千名员工的奉献与自豪，我深知这一里程碑对他们每一个人将有多么重要。作为有史以来建造的最先进潜艇之一，HMS Agamemnon将在进一步加强我们本土及整个北约的安全方面发挥重要作用。

items.title: US F-35 fighters to debut in Indian multinational air exercise
items.author: Anjana Pasricha
items.summary: The participation of F-35 stealth fighters in the Indian drills signals that New Delhi’s and Washington’s defense ties remain steady.
items.body:
NEW DELHI — The U.S. Air Force’s F-35 fighter jets are joining a multinational air exercise hosted by India, bringing a fifth-generation fighter to Indian air drills for the first time and giving the Indian Air Force and other participants direct exposure to operating alongside an advanced stealth aircraft.

The drills get underway Saturday at the Jodhpur air base in Rajasthan state, which lies about 200 kilometers from India’s border with Pakistan. Eight countries are participating and 32 more are attending as observers.

India does not have a fifth-generation fighter aircraft. It will deploy its major fighters such as Rafales, Su-30MKIs, Tejas and the Mirage 2000 in the combat drills. France is bringing Rafale jets and the United Arab Emirates is bringing F-16s.

At a time when India’s rival China is rapidly expanding its fleet of fifth-generation fighters, the exercise could give the Indian Air Force a first-hand experience of tactical missions with advanced stealth aircraft and gain insight into how such jets can integrate sensor data, operate as part of a networked force and complicate detection by adversary radars.

Indian vice chief of the Air Staff, Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit, said as the character of warfare changes, the drills, named “Tarang Shakti,” will help participants prepare for the challenges “of tomorrow.”

“We do not conduct Tarang Shakti to demonstrate what we already know. We conduct it to discover what we still need to learn,” he told reporters on Wednesday. “Our partners bring their own operational experience. Bringing these together in a realistic training environment allows us to test assumptions, challenge procedures, understand different methods of employing air power and improve interoperability.”

The participation of F-35 stealth fighters in the Indian drills also underscores that New Delhi’s and Washington’s defense ties remain on a steady keel, despite their broader relationship coming under some strain over trade disputes and India’s purchases of Russian oil.

While the U.S. stealth fighter has twice featured at defense exhibitions in India and the Indian Air Force operated alongside F-35s during joint exercises in Australia two years ago, the upcoming drill marks the first time the aircraft will undertake tactical missions with Indian fighters from an Indian airbase.

Dixit said the air force also wants to use the air exercises to test lessons learned during India’s brief conflict with Pakistan in May last year in which both countries deployed fighter jets.

Besides the United States, France and UAE, other countries bringing air assets like surveillance and transport aircraft are Germany, Australia, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Greece.

The drills are being held soon after India held bilateral air exercises with Japan in which Tokyo deployed its fighter aircraft, the Mitsubishi F-2A fighter aircraft in India for the first time. That exercise, held Sept. 9-22, was seen as a signal of growing defense ties between New Delhi and Tokyo amid an assertive China in the Indo-Pacific.

“Our partnership has progressed beyond simply conducting exercises together to refining our tactical capabilities at a practical level,” Japan’s Air Self-Defense Force Chief of Staff Gen. Takehiro Morita said Sept. 20 in Jodhpur where the drill was conducted.

The multinational air drill starting Saturday will conclude on Oct. 12.
zhParas: 新德里——美国空军的F-35战斗机正在参加印度主办的多国空中演习，这是第五代战斗机首次参加印度空中演习，使印度空军和其他参与者能够直接体验与先进隐形飞机协同作战。
演习将于周六在拉贾斯坦邦的焦特布尔空军基地开始，该基地距离印度与巴基斯坦边境约200公里。八个国家参演，另有32个国家作为观察员出席。
印度没有第五代战斗机。它将在此次作战演习中部署其主力战斗机，如Rafale、Su-30MKI、Tejas和Mirage 2000。法国将派出Rafale战斗机，阿拉伯联合酋长国将派出F-16。
在印度的对手中国迅速扩充其第五代战斗机机队之际，此次演习可能使印度空军获得使用先进隐形飞机执行战术任务的第一手经验，并深入了解此类战机如何整合传感器数据、作为网络化部队的一部分作战，以及如何使敌方雷达更难探测。
印度空军副参谋长阿舒托什·迪克西特（Ashutosh Dixit）空军中将表示，随着战争性质的变化，代号“塔朗·沙克蒂”的演习将帮助参与者为“明天”的挑战做好准备。
“我们举行‘塔朗·沙克蒂’演习不是为了展示我们已经知道的东西。我们举行演习是为了发现我们仍需学习的内容，”他周三告诉记者。“我们的伙伴带来了他们自己的作战经验。将这些经验汇聚在逼真的训练环境中，使我们能够检验假设、挑战程序、了解运用空中力量的不同方法并提高互操作性。”
F-35隐形战斗机参加印度演习也凸显出，尽管新德里与华盛顿的整体关系因贸易争端和印度购买俄罗斯石油而承受一定压力，但两国的防务关系仍保持稳定。
尽管美国隐形战斗机曾两次在印度的防务展上亮相，且印度空军两年前在澳大利亚的联合演习中曾与F-35协同行动，但即将举行的演习标志着该型飞机首次从印度空军基地与印度战斗机一起执行战术任务。
迪克西特（Dixit）表示，印度空军还希望借助此次空中演习，检验去年5月印度与巴基斯坦短暂冲突中汲取的经验教训，当时两国均出动了战斗机。
除美国、法国和阿联酋外，其他派出监视与运输机等空中装备的国家还包括德国、澳大利亚、孟加拉国、斯里兰卡和希腊。
此次演习举行前不久，印度刚与日本举行双边空中演习，东京首次将其战斗机——三菱F-2A战斗机部署至印度。该演习于9月9日至22日举行，被视为在印太地区中国日益强势的背景下，新德里与东京防务关系不断加深的信号。
“我们的伙伴关系已超越仅仅共同举行演习的阶段，进入了在实际层面精进战术能力的阶段，”日本航空自卫队航空幕僚长森田武宏（Takehiro Morita）上将9月20日在演习举办地焦特布尔说。
这场于周六开始的多国空中演习将于10月12日结束。

此次演习举行前不久，印度刚与日本举行双边空中演习，东京首次将其战斗机——三菱F-2A战斗机部署至印度。该演习于9月9日至22日举行，被视为在印太地区中国日益强势的背景下，新德里与东京防务关系不断加深的信号。

“我们的伙伴关系已超越仅仅共同举行演习的阶段，进入了在实际层面精进战术能力的阶段，”日本航空自卫队航空幕僚长森田武宏（Takehiro Morita）上将9月20日在演习举办地焦特布尔说。

这场于周六开始的多国空中演习将于10月12日结束。

items.title: British companies to access prized Ukraine data to develop AI drone swarms
items.summary: British companies will gain access to a goldmine of battlefield data from Ukraine for the first time to develop new AI models for advanced drone swarms.
items.body:
New AI-enabled drone swarms will be made in Britain, using battlefield data from Ukraine.

Coveted database available to up to 12 UK companies under inaugural competition which will move to testing at pace.

This advanced technology could boost the UK’s ability to deliver supplies and target enemy capabilities, as the Prime Minister’s AI Taskforce puts AI to work to strengthen national security and reindustrialise Britain.

The UK is the first international partner to access Ukraine’s coveted Avengers AI Labs, following a landmark deal struck by Prime Minister Andy Burnham and President Zelenskyy in Kyiv. The database holds imagery and video gathered by uncrewed aerial systems in Ukraine, using daylight and thermal sensors, and is used to develop, train and evaluate AI models.

The Ministry of Defence (MOD) is now inviting UK companies to submit proposals for how they would use the data to create AI models for the next generation of battlefield drones. This is the first competition under the UK-Ukraine AI Partnership and could see the creation of models that let drone swarms keep working when communications are degraded or satellite navigation is unavailable.

Drone swarms can fly, swim or drive autonomously, using AI to work together, identify threats and targets and reach decisions, always with appropriate human involvement. For UK forces, that means a small number of sailors, soldiers and aircrew could direct large numbers of drones at once, on tasks from logistics resupply to precise targeting of enemy capabilities and hunting submarines in the North Atlantic.

This comes as the Prime Minister drove forward global work on AI at the UN General Assembly in New York, both to ensure it is being used as a force for good and to maximise opportunities to use the technology to deliver safety and security for people at home. The Prime Minister announced the launch of work between the UK and US on a new AI and Autonomy partnership. This collaboration will help the UK protect critical national infrastructure, from sea lanes to air space – enabling us to detect threats and deter our adversaries using the latest AI technology developed on both sides of the Atlantic.

Defence Secretary, Wes Streeting MP said:

Ukraine is the frontline of freedom for us all. On my recent visit to Kyiv, I saw first-hand the courage and resilience of the Ukrainian people. I also saw the extraordinary innovation which is allowing them to repel Putin’s illegal and unprovoked invasion. This world-first access to real battlefield data will allow British companies to continue pushing the frontier of defence innovation, deterring our enemies and making us safer at home as well as further strengthening Ukraine.

Ukraine is the frontline of freedom for us all. On my recent visit to Kyiv, I saw first-hand the courage and resilience of the Ukrainian people. I also saw the extraordinary innovation which is allowing them to repel Putin’s illegal and unprovoked invasion.

This world-first access to real battlefield data will allow British companies to continue pushing the frontier of defence innovation, deterring our enemies and making us safer at home as well as further strengthening Ukraine.

AI Minister Kanishka Narayan said:

This is the Prime Minister’s AI Taskforce delivering: bringing together Ukraine’s hard-won battlefield experience with Britain’s best AI companies to develop and deploy capabilities faster. It is exactly the kind of practical partnership the Taskforce was set up to drive, supporting our ally Ukraine while strengthening sovereign capability here in Britain.

This is the Prime Minister’s AI Taskforce delivering: bringing together Ukraine’s hard-won battlefield experience with Britain’s best AI companies to develop and deploy capabilities faster.

It is exactly the kind of practical partnership the Taskforce was set up to drive, supporting our ally Ukraine while strengthening sovereign capability here in Britain.

The database includes sensor information from over 6 million detections of objects, such as tanks, artillery, air defence systems, infantry, and aerial targets, including Shahed drones and reconnaissance Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles.

Access to the extensive database will be initially available for up to 12 UK companies and their proposals must be applicable to both Ukrainian and British defence requirements. To advance this work at pace, those companies will be selected in just a matter of weeks and their exploitation of the data is expected to begin soon after.

The work is being led by the MOD’s Taskforce RAID (Rapid AI Delivery) – a team dedicated to ensuring soldiers, sailors and aircrew have access to smarter technology that helps them make better decisions, take on dangerous tasks with less risk, and outpace adversaries who are rapidly developing their own AI capabilities.

The activity demonstrates the Prime Minister’s AI Taskforce turning the Government’s ambitions for AI into real-world capability. Working jointly with the MOD’s Taskforce RAID they are harnessing British expertise to strengthen national security, support our allies and reindustrialise Britain by building the industries of the future here in the UK.

The recent agreement, which forms a key part of the UK and Ukraine’s 100 Year Partnership, underlines the close relationship between both countries to drive global security and stability and ensure Ukraine has the capability and means to defend itself from Russia’s barbaric invasion.

The MOD is seeking innovative proposals covering one or more of the following areas within drone operations:

Autonomous Target Recognition: AI-enabled detection, classification, prioritisation and tracking of operationally relevant objects across complex and contested environments.

Distributed Decision-Making: Enabling multiple autonomous systems to dynamically adapt routes, priorities and behaviours in response to changing battlefield conditions, without relying on a single point of control.

Adaptive Mission Execution: AI approaches enabling multiple autonomous systems to coordinate actions under constrained communications and decentralised control.

Collaborative Sensing and Information Fusion: Methods for sharing, fusing and exploiting information across multiple platforms and sensors to improve situational awareness and mission effectiveness.

For further details about the competition, and to apply, please go to the following: Submission Portal
zhParas: 新型AI赋能的无人机蜂群将在英国制造，使用来自乌克兰的战场数据。
在首次竞赛中，这一令人垂涎的数据库将向最多12家英国公司开放，相关进程将快速转入测试阶段。
这项先进技术可能提升英国投送补给和打击敌方能力的能力，因为首相的AI特别工作组正让AI发挥作用，以加强国家安全并推动英国再工业化。
英国成为首个获准使用乌克兰令人垂涎的Avengers AI Labs的国际伙伴，此前英国首相安迪·伯纳姆 (Andy Burnham) 与总统泽连斯基 (Zelenskyy) 在基辅达成了一项具有里程碑意义的协议。该数据库存有乌克兰无人机系统使用日光和热成像传感器采集的图像和视频，用于开发、训练和评估AI模型。
英国国防部 (MOD) 现在邀请英国公司提交方案，说明它们将如何利用这些数据为下一代战场无人机制作AI模型。这是英乌AI伙伴关系下的首项竞赛，可能催生出这样的模型：在通信降级或卫星导航不可用时，让无人机蜂群仍能继续运作。
无人机蜂群能够自主飞行、游泳或行驶，利用AI协同行动、识别威胁与目标并作出决策，且始终有适当的人工参与。对英国部队而言，这意味着少数水兵、士兵和空勤人员就能同时指挥大量无人机，执行从后勤补给到精确打击敌方能力，再到在北大西洋猎潜等任务。
此时，首相正在纽约联合国大会上推动AI领域的全球工作，既确保AI被用于善途，也最大限度利用该技术为本国民众提供安全保障。首相宣布英国与美国启动一项新的AI与自主性伙伴关系工作。这一合作将帮助英国保护关键国家基础设施，从海上航道到空域，使我们能够利用大西洋两岸开发的最新AI技术探测威胁、威慑对手。
国防大臣韦斯·斯特里廷 (Wes Streeting) 议员表示：
乌克兰是我们所有人自由的前线。在我最近访问基辅期间，我亲眼目睹了乌克兰人民的勇气与韧性。我也看到了非凡的创新，这正使他们能够击退普京非法且无端的入侵。这种全球首次获取真实战场数据的机会，将使英国公司能够继续推进国防创新的前沿，威慑我们的敌人，让我们在国内更安全，并进一步加强乌克兰。
乌克兰是我们所有人自由的前线。在我最近访问基辅期间，我亲眼目睹了乌克兰人民的勇气与韧性。我也看到了非凡的创新，这正使他们能够击退普京非法且无端的入侵。
这种全球首次获取真实战场数据的机会，将使英国公司能够继续推进国防创新的前沿，威慑我们的敌人，让我们在国内更安全，并进一步加强乌克兰。
人工智能大臣卡尼什卡·纳拉扬（Kanishka Narayan）表示：
这正是首相人工智能工作组交出的成果：将乌克兰来之不易的战场经验与英国最优秀的人工智能公司结合起来，以更快地开发和部署能力。这正是该工作组成立之初所要推动的那类务实伙伴关系，既支持我们的盟友乌克兰，又增强英国本土的主权能力。
这正是首相人工智能工作组交出的成果：将乌克兰来之不易的战场经验与英国最优秀的人工智能公司结合起来，以更快地开发和部署能力。
这正是该工作组成立之初所要推动的那类务实伙伴关系，既支持我们的盟友乌克兰，又增强英国本土的主权能力。
该数据库包含来自超过 600 万次目标探测的传感器信息，探测对象包括坦克、火炮、防空系统、步兵和空中目标，其中包括 Shahed 无人机和侦察无人航空器。
该庞大数据库的访问权限最初将向最多12家英国公司开放，其提案必须同时适用于乌克兰和英国的防务需求。为加快这项工作，这些公司将在短短数周内选定，预计其对该数据的利用不久后便会开始。
这项工作由英国国防部的“快速人工智能交付”特别工作组（Taskforce RAID）牵头——该团队致力于确保士兵、水兵和空勤人员能够使用更智能的技术，从而帮助他们做出更好的决策、以更低风险执行危险任务，并领先于正在快速研发自身人工智能能力的对手。
这项活动表明，首相的人工智能特别工作组正将政府对人工智能的雄心转化为现实能力。该工作组与英国国防部的 Taskforce RAID 协同工作，利用英国的专业能力来加强国家安全、支持我们的盟友，并通过在英国本土建设未来产业来实现英国的再工业化。
近期达成的这项协议是英国与乌克兰“百年伙伴关系”的关键组成部分，凸显了两国之间的紧密关系，旨在推动全球安全与稳定，并确保乌克兰拥有抵御俄罗斯野蛮入侵的能力和手段。
英国国防部正在寻求创新提案，涵盖无人机作战中的以下一个或多个领域：
自主目标识别：在复杂且充满对抗的环境中，利用人工智能对与作战相关的目标进行探测、分类、优先级排序和跟踪。
分布式决策：使多个自主系统能够根据不断变化的战场条件动态调整路线、优先级和行为，而不依赖单一控制点。
自适应任务执行：人工智能方法使多个自主系统能够在通信受限和去中心化控制下协调行动。
协同感知与信息融合：跨多个平台和传感器共享、融合和利用信息，以提高态势感知和任务效能的方法。
如需了解该竞赛的更多详情并申请，请访问以下地址：提交门户

items.title: CEOs from sensitive sectors to receive briefings on Russia threats
items.summary: CEOs from the most sensitive sectors of the economy will receive closed-door briefings on threats posed by Russia
items.body:
Security Minister Dan Jarvis and Armed Forces Minister Louise Sandher-Jones to chair closed-door threat-briefings on Russia.

Representatives from Defence and Critical National Infrastructure sectors to be invited to Whitehall.

Comes after the Prime Minister used his speech to the UN General Assembly earlier this week to call out Russia for its hybrid attacks and actions in Ukraine

Critical National Infrastructure providers and defence companies are set to be invited for briefings from security and defence ministers on the threat posed by Russia.

Security Minister Dan Jarvis will chair a threat briefing with industry bodies representing CNI providers, while Armed Forces Minister Louise Sandher-Jones will chair a threat briefing with industry bodies representing defence firms.

Russia poses an enduring and significant threat to the UK and its interests around the world. The state and its proxies knowingly seek to disrupt businesses and organisations that underpin the British way of life or are vital to the defence of Ukraine. They use tactics like cyber attacks, sabotage and disinformation to take organisations offline, disrupt activity, and weaken trust.

The briefings will draw on world class intelligence capabilities and comes after the Prime Minister used his speech to the UN General Assembly earlier this week to call out Russia for its actions in Ukraine, the UK and elsewhere.

Security Minister, Dan Jarvis, said:

Strong defences are built on a clear understanding of the threat. That’s why I’ll be chairing this briefing, to share world-class intelligence with some of the most important organisations in the country, to ensure they understand and are prepared for the threats we face. We’ll be focusing on the actions they can take in partnership with government, to help keep our country safe.

Strong defences are built on a clear understanding of the threat.

That’s why I’ll be chairing this briefing, to share world-class intelligence with some of the most important organisations in the country, to ensure they understand and are prepared for the threats we face.

We’ll be focusing on the actions they can take in partnership with government, to help keep our country safe.

Minister for the Armed Forces, Louise Sandher-Jones, said:

Russia is actively seeking to disrupt the organisations that form the bedrock of our national security. By bringing government and defence industry leaders together, we can deepen our shared understanding of the threat and strengthen our collective resilience. Protecting our defence sector is essential to keeping Britain secure.

Russia is actively seeking to disrupt the organisations that form the bedrock of our national security.

By bringing government and defence industry leaders together, we can deepen our shared understanding of the threat and strengthen our collective resilience.

Protecting our defence sector is essential to keeping Britain secure.

It follows similar briefings held earlier this year to update university leaders and political parties on the threat of foreign interference and the actions they could take to strengthen national security.

The briefings will sit alongside the support the UK Government already provides to help protect defence firms and Critical National Infrastructure providers from threats, including: specialist policing through organisations like the Civil Nuclear Constabulary; world class cyber expertise through the National Cyber Security Centre; and tailored security advice through the National Protective Security Authority.

Just this month, the Crown Prosecution Service charged a British man with offences under the National Security Act, after he allegedly engaged in conduct to prepare an act of sabotage and received instructions from an individual believed to be linked to the GRU Volunteer Corps.
zhParas: 安全大臣丹·贾维斯（Dan Jarvis）和武装部队大臣路易丝·桑德-琼斯（Louise Sandher-Jones）将主持关于俄罗斯的闭门威胁简报会。
国防和关键国家基础设施领域的代表将受邀前往白厅。
此前，首相在本周早些时候向联合国大会发表演讲时，点名批评俄罗斯的混合攻击及其在乌克兰的行动。
关键国家基础设施供应商和国防企业将受邀参加安全与国防大臣就俄罗斯所构成威胁举行的简报会。
安全大臣丹·贾维斯（Dan Jarvis）将主持一场与代表关键国家基础设施供应商的行业机构进行的威胁简报会，武装部队大臣路易丝·桑德-琼斯（Louise Sandher-Jones）则将主持一场与代表国防企业的行业机构进行的威胁简报会。
俄罗斯对英国及其在世界各地的利益构成持久而重大的威胁。该国及其代理人蓄意寻求破坏支撑英国生活方式、或对乌克兰防御至关重要的企业和组织。他们使用网络攻击、破坏活动和虚假信息等手法，使相关组织断网下线、扰乱其活动并削弱信任。
这些简报会将依托世界一流的情报能力，此前首相在本周早些时候向联合国大会发表演讲时，点名批评俄罗斯在乌克兰、英国及其他地区的行动。
安全大臣丹·贾维斯（Dan Jarvis）表示：
牢固的防御建立在清楚认识威胁的基础上。正因如此，我将主持这次简报会，与国内一些最重要的机构分享世界级情报，确保他们了解并准备好应对我们所面临的威胁。我们将重点讨论他们可与政府合作采取的行动，以帮助维护国家安全。
牢固的防御建立在清楚认识威胁的基础上。
正因如此，我将主持这次简报会，与国内一些最重要的机构分享世界级情报，确保他们了解并准备好应对我们所面临的威胁。
我们将重点讨论他们可与政府合作采取的行动，以帮助维护国家安全。
武装部队国务大臣路易丝·桑德-琼斯（Louise Sandher-Jones）表示：
俄罗斯正积极寻求破坏构成我们国家安全基石的组织。通过将政府和国防工业领导人聚集在一起，我们可以加深对威胁的共同理解，并增强我们的集体韧性。保护我们的国防部门对保障英国安全至关重要。
俄罗斯正积极寻求破坏构成我们国家安全基石的组织。
通过将政府和国防工业领导人聚集在一起，我们可以加深对威胁的共同理解，并增强我们的集体韧性。
保护我们的国防产业对保障英国安全至关重要。
此次通报之前，今年早些时候已举行过类似通报会，向大学领导人和各政党通报外国干涉的威胁以及他们可采取哪些行动来加强国家安全。
这些通报会将与英国政府已提供的支持共同发挥作用，帮助保护国防企业和关键国家基础设施提供商免受威胁，这些支持包括：通过民用核警察局等机构提供的专业警务；通过国家网络安全中心提供的世界一流网络专业知识；以及通过国家保护安全局提供的量身定制安全建议。
就在本月，英国皇家检察署依据《国家安全法》指控一名英国男子犯有相关罪行，此前他涉嫌从事准备实施破坏行动的行为，并接受了一名据信与GRU志愿军团有关联的人员的指示。

items.summary: The Rapid AI Delivery Taskforce (TF RAID) is running a competition to access Ukraine’s Avengers Labs platform to enhance autonomous drone swarming and collaborative drone operations.
items.body:
TF RAID Avengers: AI swarming competition

The Rapid AI Delivery Taskforce (TF RAID) is running a competition to access Ukraine’s Avengers Labs platform to enhance autonomous drone swarming and collaborative drone operations.

Ministry of Defence

25 September 2026

TF RAID Avengers: AI swarming competition overview

PDF , 1.84 MB , 7 pages

MS Word Document , 5.88 MB

This file is in an OpenDocument format

The Rapid AI Delivery Taskforce (TF RAID) is running an open competition inviting proposals from UK industry on how to use new access to Avengers Labs datasets to enhance autonomous drone swarming and collaborative drone operations. Proposals should have the potential to benefit both UK and Ukrainian armed forces.

Avengers Labs is a Ukrainian government platform containing imagery and footage of various ground and aerial targets collected in Ukraine. This is the inaugural competition under the UK-Ukraine AI partnership.

How to apply

Read the competition overview document to understand the challenge requirements.

Answer all of the questions outlined in the submission template.

Submit your PDF proposal addressing the challenge requirements through the submission portal.

briefing call to UK industry: 7 October 2026

deadline for submissions: 11:59pm BST on 22 October 2026

MOD review of submissions and companies: 23 to 30 October 2026

selected companies for Phase 1 access to Avengers Labs notified: by 6 November 2026

Sign up for emails or print this page

items.title: Long-Term Growth in Child Mental Health Expenditures, 2004-2023
items.author: Hao Yu
items.summary: This paper estimates trends in mental health expenditures, probability of use and expenditures per user for US children aged 2-17 from 2004 to 2023.
items.body:
ResearchPosted on rand.org Sep 25, 2026Published in: Health Affairs Scholar, qxag250 (2026). DOI: 10.1093/haschl/qxag250

Investment in mental health treatment for children has grown substantially, but whether this reflects more treatment recipients, higher spending per user, or both has not been examined.

To estimate trends in mental health expenditures, probability of use and expenditures per user for US children aged 2–17 from 2004 to 2023.

Two-part models were estimated to predict inflation adjusted health expenditure data from the 2004-2023 Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (unweighted N=153,622) to assess overall trends and variation by age-group and insurance coverage.

Total annual mental health expenditures increased from $10.9B to $37.9B, rising from 4.4% to 8.1% of total health expenditure per child (mean individual-level ratio among children with any health care expenditure). The probability of mental health service use more than doubled (6.3% to 13.0%, +0.35 percentage points/year), while expenditure per user grew from $2,816 to $5,178 (+3.3%/year). Relative to the 2004 baseline those age 2-5 had the greatest growth in both service use and expenditure per user. Expenditure per user grew substantially faster for privately-insured than for Medicaid-covered children.

Child mental health treatment expenditures have grown dramatically over the past two decades, with particularly large increases for those ages two to five.

旨在估计2004年至2023年美国2—17岁儿童在心理健康支出、使用概率和每名使用者支出方面的趋势。
拟合两部分模型，以预测2004—2023年 Medical Expenditure Panel Survey（未加权 N=153,622）中经通胀调整的卫生支出数据，并评估总体趋势以及按年龄组和保险覆盖情况划分的差异。

过去二十年，儿童心理健康治疗支出急剧增长，其中2至5岁儿童的增幅尤其大。

items.title: Newest AIM-9X Missiles Not Meeting Operational Availability Goal
items.author: Todd South
items.summary: One of the Air Force and Navy’s most common air-to-air missiles is falling short of a key readiness metric, and the services are ramping up stocks of a vital air-to-ground missile, according to recent Pentagon reports. The post Newest AIM-9X Missiles Not Meeting Operational Availability Goal appeared first on Air & Space Forces Magazine .
items.body:
One of the Air Force and Navy’s most common air-to-air missiles is falling short of a key readiness metric, and the services are ramping up stocks of a vital air-to-ground missile, according to recent Pentagon reports.

The Modernized Selected Acquisition Reports on the AIM-9 and the Joint Air-to-Surface Standoff Missile, cleared for publication in July, lay out progress and shortfalls and provide a snapshot for the health of these key munitions.

According to the reports, the AIM-9X Sidewinder Block II is facing operational availability shortages. The Warfighting Acquisition University defines operational availability as “the degree … to which one can expect a piece of equipment or weapon system to work properly when it is required.” The Air Force is at 58 percent operational availability for the latest version of the Sidewinder, and the Navy is at 78 percent—the requirement is 86 percent, the report says.

That shortage is forcing squadrons to face lower training asset availability, preventing fighter pilots from having the requisite number of Captive Air Training Missiles. Those CATMs have live seekers and guidance units that pilots use on regular training sorties to practice locking onto targets, tracking high off-boresight angles, and simulating missile shots.

When enough training pods are nonoperational, aircrews don’t have enough rounds to fly daily air-to-air tactical training with realistic seekers.

The Air Force and Navy plan to buy more than 11,000 AIM-9X Block II missiles, which are infrared-guided, short-range, supersonic air-to-air weapons.

But reliability problems with integrating a new circuit processor into the latest configuration, the AIM-9X-4, have “impacted missile reliability and halted testing.”

As a result, a software update called Operational Flight Software 10.4, meant to integrate the advanced guidance control unit and inertial measurement unit hardware upgrades, will not be fielded.

Report authors note that the follow-on software that will fix the problem won’t be ready until September 2027.

AIM-9X maker RTX declined to comment on the report.

JASSM and LRASM Work

As the two services work out the air-to-air missile problem, both are seeking to expand their plans for the Joint Air-to-Surface Standoff Missiles and its cousin, the Long-Range Anti-Ship Missile.

Another shared munition between USAF and the Navy, the JASSM is a linchpin munition with multiple variants fielded and in production.

The AGM-158A JASSM is a 14-foot-long missile that strikes beyond 200 miles and has been a staple of U.S. aircraft use since 2001. The B-1B Lancer, B-2A Spirit, B-52H Stratofortress, F-15 variants, F-16 variants, and C-130 Hercules can carry it and its variants, and the F-35A Lightning II and B-21 Raider are planned to integrate it.

The AGM-158B JASSM-Extended Range can hit targets at more than twice the distance, with public reports showing ranges of more than 500 miles.

The AGM-158C LRASM has a range closer to the baseline JASSM but is equipped with radio-frequency seekers designed to strike large, moving targets such as ships.

According to the recent selected acquisition report, the joint program office between the two services had delivered 5,348 JASSM variants to the Pentagon as of April, according to the report.

Current production capacity sits at about 600 JASSMs annually, with near-term plans to reach 860 missiles a year.

More mid-term plans call for ramping up that production to 1,280 missiles annually by fiscal year 2030 and 1,880 by fiscal 2032, according to the report.

A March $52 million contract modification to LRASM will raise the missile’s production from 240 per year to 320 per year beginning in fiscal 2029, according to the report.

Lockheed announced a new JAASM option at AFA’s Air, Space, & Cyber conference earlier this month, the AGM-158 FLEX.

The company sees FLEX, a modular, designed munition which has swappable nose and launch options, as another way to offer a variety of strike options in the JASSM form factor.

“The AGM-158 FLEX airframe concept was driven by a strategic need to keep pace with rapidly evolving threats, insert emerging technologies quickly, manage obsolescence, and provide, at scale, a cost-effective missile family that can be repurposed for a wide range of missions while delivering timely, relevant capability to the warfighter,” a Lockheed Martin spokesperson told Air & Space Forces Magazine via email.

The stockpile plus-up, however, will use current factory space via expansion efforts, the Eglin spokesperson wrote, and “will not require a new facility construction.”

Lockheed’s investment strategy includes $8 to $9 million through 2030 to meet heightened munitions demand.

“We are expanding production and building and modernizing more than 20 facilities in Arkansas, Alabama, Florida, Massachusetts, and Texas,” Lockheed spokesman Scott Swofford told Air & Space Forces Magazine in an email. “This includes upgrading existing facilities and incorporating advanced manufacturing techniques, production lines, tooling, and plant layouts to meet urgent production demand.”

Software, Paint, and Engines

Like the AIM-9X, the JASSM also faced software integration problems, specifically with its 54.0.02 flight software update. But an Eglin spokesperson said the software had received fielding approval since data for the selected acquisition report was gathered in April, and that “there are no impacts to combat readiness.”

The Air Force is also pressing to accelerate the integration of the Universal Armament Interface, a software architecture to standardize aircraft mission systems-weapons interface, but this has introduced “added software risk,” according to the report.

But the Eglin spokesperson told Air & Space Forces Magazine that the UAI program has “made no changes to the delivery schedule” of the JASSMs.

“Integration activities remain on track to deliver planned capabilities as scheduled. Software risk is being actively managed through early software-in-the-loop integration, resource prioritization, and agile contract actions,” the spokesperson said.

Separately, the report noted that in an inspection of 1,356 JASSMs, inspectors flagged 49 missiles for depot-level maintenance and overhaul, mostly due to stealth coating defects. The report says that issue won’t be resolved until 2029.

Lockheed switched from the flat gray paint scheme to a semi-gloss black coating to reduce radar and visual signatures. The new coating can absorb and deflect electromagnetic energy more easily during longer flight times used by the new, extended-range variants.

The shift began in 2021 with the Lot 19 contract award for the AGM-158B-2 variant.

The Eglin spokesperson said that both the program office and Lockheed Martin are “exploring contracting actions to increase repair capacity and return serviceable missiles to the field more efficiently.”

Beyond software updates, the Air Force also spent $200 million in fiscal 2025 to procure and mature a second-source engine for the LRASM and JASSM-ERs.

“Investing in a second engine source for the AGM-158 is essential to securing our supply chain and ramping up production of critical long-range strike weapons,” the Eglin spokesperson said. “By establishing a second production line, we eliminate manufacturing bottlenecks, drive competition, and secure deliveries of JASSM and LRASM to the warfighter.”
zhParas: 空军和海军最常用的空对空导弹之一未达到一项关键战备指标，而这两个军种正在加紧增加一种关键空对地导弹的库存，据五角大楼近期报告。
关于 AIM-9 和联合空对地防区外导弹的《现代化选定采购报告》已于7月获准发布，其中列出了进展与不足，并提供了这些关键弹药状况的概览。
根据这些报告，AIM-9X Sidewinder Block II 正面临作战可用性不足。作战采办大学将作战可用性定义为“在需要时，人们可以期望某件装备或武器系统正常工作的程度”。报告称，空军最新型 Sidewinder 的作战可用性为58%，海军为78%，而要求为86%。
这一短缺正迫使中队面临训练资产可用性降低，使战斗机飞行员无法获得所需数量的挂载式空中训练导弹（CATM）。这些 CATM 装有真实导引头和制导单元，飞行员在例行训练架次中使用它们练习锁定目标、跟踪大离轴角以及模拟发射导弹。
当足够多的训练吊舱无法使用时，机组人员就没有足够的弹量来进行使用真实导引头的每日空对空战术训练。
空军和海军计划采购超过11,000枚 AIM-9X Block II 导弹，这是一种红外制导、短程、超音速空对空武器。
但将新型电路处理器集成到最新配置 AIM-9X-4 中时出现的可靠性问题，“影响了导弹可靠性并导致测试暂停”。
因此，名为 Operational Flight Software 10.4 的软件更新将不会部署，该更新原本旨在集成先进制导控制单元和惯性测量单元的硬件升级。
报告作者指出，用于解决该问题的后续软件要到2027年9月才能就绪。
AIM-9X的制造商RTX拒绝就该报告置评。
JASSM与LRASM项目
在两个军种设法解决空空导弹问题的同时，双方都在寻求扩大各自对联合空对地防区外导弹及其同类型号——远程反舰导弹的计划。
JASSM是美国空军与海军共用的又一型弹药，是一种关键弹药，已有多个型号列装并处于生产中。
AGM-158A JASSM导弹长14 feet，可在200 miles以外实施打击，自2001年以来一直是美军飞机使用的常备弹药。B-1B Lancer、B-2A Spirit、B-52H Stratofortress、F-15各型、F-16各型以及C-130 Hercules均可携带该弹及其改进型，F-35A Lightning II和B-21 Raider也计划整合该弹。
AGM-158B JASSM-增程型能在两倍以上的距离上打击目标，公开报道显示其射程超过500 miles。
AGM-158C LRASM的射程更接近基本型JASSM，但装备了用于打击舰船等大型移动目标的射频导引头。
根据近期发布的选定采购报告，截至4月，两个军种的联合项目办公室已向五角大楼交付5348枚JASSM各型导弹，报告称。
目前年产能约为600枚JASSM，近期计划达到每年860枚导弹。
报告称，更多中期计划要求到2030财年将产量提升至每年1280枚导弹，到2032财年提升至1880枚。
报告称，3月对LRASM的一项5200万美元合同修改将从2029财年开始把该导弹的年产量从240枚提高到320枚。
洛克希德公司本月早些时候在AFA的航空、太空与网络会议上宣布了一种新的JAASM选项，即AGM-158 FLEX。
该公司认为，FLEX是一种模块化设计的弹药，具有可更换的前端和发射选项，是在JASSM外形规格内提供多种打击选项的另一种方式。
洛克希德·马丁公司发言人通过电子邮件告诉《空天部队杂志》：“AGM-158 FLEX机体概念源于一种战略需求：跟上快速演变的威胁，快速嵌入新兴技术，管理过时问题，并大规模提供一种可改用于广泛任务的、具有成本效益的导弹家族，同时为作战人员提供及时、相关的能力。”
然而，埃格林发言人写道，库存增加将通过扩建利用现有工厂空间，并“不需要新建一座设施。”
洛克希德的投资战略包括到2030年投入800万至900万美元，以满足激增的弹药需求。
“我们正在扩大生产，并在阿肯色州、阿拉巴马州、佛罗里达州、马萨诸塞州和得克萨斯州新建和现代化改造20多座设施，”洛克希德公司发言人斯科特·斯沃福德（Scott Swofford）在给《空天军杂志》的电子邮件中表示。“这包括升级现有设施，并引入先进制造技术、生产线、工装和厂房布局，以满足紧迫的生产需求。”
软件、涂料和发动机
与AIM-9X一样，JASSM也面临软件集成问题，具体涉及其54.0.02飞行软件更新。但埃格林空军基地的一位发言人表示，自4月收集所选采购报告数据以来，该软件已获得列装批准，并且“对战备没有影响”。
空军还在推动加快集成通用武器接口——一种用于规范飞机任务系统与武器接口的软件架构——但报告称，这带来了“额外的软件风险”。
但埃格林空军基地发言人告诉《空天军杂志》，UAI项目“未对JASSM的交付进度做出任何更改”。
该发言人说：“集成活动仍按计划推进，将如期交付既定能力。软件风险正通过早期软件在环集成、资源优先级排序和敏捷合同行动得到积极管控。”
另外，报告指出，在对1356枚JASSM的检查中，检查人员标记49枚导弹需要基地级维修和大修，主要原因是隐身涂层缺陷。报告称，该问题要到2029年才能解决。
洛克希德（Lockheed）将平面灰色涂装方案改为半光泽黑色涂层，以降低雷达和视觉特征信号。新涂层在新式增程型导弹所采用的更长飞行时间内，能更轻易地吸收并偏转电磁能量。
这一转变始于2021年，当时授予了AGM-158B-2型的第19批次（Lot 19）合同。
埃格林（Eglin）发言人表示，项目办公室与洛克希德·马丁公司正在“探索合同举措，以提高维修能力，并更高效地将可用的导弹送回战场”。
除软件更新外，美国空军还在2025财年花费2亿美元，为LRASM和JASSM-ER采购并成熟一款第二来源发动机。
“为AGM-158投资第二发动机来源，对于保障我们的供应链、加快关键远程打击武器的生产至关重要，”埃格林发言人说。“通过建立第二条生产线，我们消除了制造瓶颈，促进了竞争，并确保向作战人员交付JASSM和LRASM。”

items.title: Last Warthog Departs Nellis as Base’s A-10 Era Comes to a Close
items.author: Steve Losey
items.summary: Nellis Air Force Base, Nev.—a longtime hub for A-10 Thunderbolt II tactical training, operational testing and maintenance—ended nearly a half-century of flying the venerable Warthog on Sept. 22. The post Last Warthog Departs Nellis as Base’s A-10 Era Comes to a Close appeared first on Air & Space Forces Magazine .
items.body:
Nellis Air Force Base, Nev.—a longtime hub for A-10 Thunderbolt II tactical training, operational testing and maintenance—ended nearly a half-century of flying the venerable Warthog on Sept. 22.

The Air Force said in a Sept. 23 statement that nearly 70 Airmen lined up on the flightline at Nellis for a final salute as the last Warthog there took off.

Nellis has flown A-10s since 1977. The base has been the Air Force’s primary proving ground for A-10 tactical employment, and units have worked to refine its software, avionics and precision weapons, the Air Force said.

The 66th Weapons Squadron at Nellis’ U.S. Air Force Weapons School has also trained more than 300 A-10 weapons officers in 100 classes, the Air Force said.

With its heavy armor and withering GAU-8 30mm cannon, the A-10 was originally built to be a Soviet tank killer and played a central role in the Gulf War against Saddam Hussein’s army. But in the Global War on Terror, the A-10 became best known as a reliable close air support platform to defend U.S. and partner nations’ ground troops when they were besieged by insurgents.

The A-10 also carries out a close air support mission dubbed Sandy during combat search and rescue operations, most recently in April during the successful rescue of two F-15E air crew who were shot down in Iran.

For years, though, the Air Force has tried to retire its A-10 fleet amid concerns that it would not be survivable against an advanced enemy. Congressional opposition has thwarted those plans before, but that has softened in recent years.

The service had pressed to retire all 162 of its remaining A-10s by the end of fiscal 2026, but after the Iran war began and the rescue of the F-15E crew, the Pentagon announced it would delay at least some Warthogs’ retirement until at least 2030.

Still, the fleet and its accompanying enterprise are slowly winding down. Davis-Monthan Air Force Base in Arizona, another longtime A-10 hub, graduated its last class of new Warthog pilots in April and held its farewell flights for its last aircraft in July. The maintenance depot for the A-10, at Hill Air Force Base, Utah, also closed this year.

The Air Force stressed that while the A-10 is retiring, the service will not let its close air support capability fade.

“Foundational tactical expertise, operational roles and personnel are transitioning to multirole and advanced fighter platforms across the service,” the Air Force said in its statement.

The F-35, for example, is taking on CAS and combat search-and-rescue roles, the service said, taking advantage of its fifth-generation stealth capabilities, advanced sensor suites, and secure data-sharing networks to carry out precision ground support missions in contested environments.

The 66th is working to teach pilots of other fighters how to take on the Warthog’s traditional missions, squadron commander Lt. Col. Ridge Flick said. The unit will also keep training combat rescue officers, pararescue Airmen, special tactics officers, and combat controllers, he said.

“We are maintaining the culture of the A-10 by involving as many other fighter communities involved in the close air support mission,” Flick said in the statement. “We are also training F-15 Eagle, F-35 Lightning II and F-16 Fighting Falcon pilots to take on some roles we have had in combat search and rescue.”

Airmen who used to repair and sustain A-10s at Nellos as part of the 757th Aircraft Maintenance Squadron’s Thunder Aircraft Maintenance Unit are being reassigned to other squadrons and airframes like the F-35 and F-16, the statement said.

“The discipline that A-10 maintainers developed over 50 years of managing airframe fatigue, wing replacements and depot-level overhauls is being integrated into those newer flight line programs,” the Air Force said.

内利斯空军基地（Nellis Air Force Base）位于内华达州，长期以来是A-10 Thunderbolt II战术训练、作战测试与维护的中心，该基地于9月22日结束了近半个世纪飞行这款久负盛名的“疣猪”的历史。

空军在9月23日的一份声明中说，当最后一架“疣猪”从内利斯起飞时，近70名空军人员在停机坪列队，向它致以最后的敬礼。

内利斯自1977年起就一直在飞A-10。空军说，该基地一直是空军A-10战术运用的主要试验场，各部队一直致力于改进其软件、航电设备和精确制导武器。

空军说，内利斯美国空军武器学校的第66武器中队还在100期培训班中培训了300多名A-10武器官。

凭借厚重装甲和威力惊人的GAU-8 30毫米机炮，A-10最初被设计为对付苏联坦克的“坦克杀手”，并在针对萨达姆·侯赛因（Saddam Hussein）军队的海湾战争中发挥了核心作用。但在全球反恐战争中，A-10最为人所知的是作为可靠的近距空中支援平台，在美国及伙伴国地面部队遭叛乱分子围困时为其提供防护。

A-10还在战斗搜救行动中执行代号“桑迪”（Sandy）的近距空中支援任务，最近一次是在4月，成功救援了两名在伊朗上空被击落的F-15E机组人员。

不过，多年来空军一直试图让A-10机队退役，原因是担心它在面对先进对手时难以生存。国会的反对此前曾使这些计划受挫，但近年来这种反对已有所缓和。

空军曾力推在2026财年结束前将其剩余的162架A-10全部退役，但在伊朗战争爆发以及F-15E机组获救之后，五角大楼宣布将至少部分“疣猪”的退役时间至少推迟到2030年。

尽管如此，这支机队及其配套体系仍在缓慢收尾。位于亚利桑那州的戴维斯-蒙森空军基地是另一个长期以来的 A-10 中心，该基地于 4 月送走了最后一批新“疣猪”飞行员，并于 7 月为其最后一批飞机举行了告别飞行。位于犹他州希尔空军基地的 A-10 维修站也在今年关闭。

美国空军强调，尽管 A-10 正在退役，但空军不会让其近距离空中支援能力消退。

“基础战术专长、作战角色和人员正在整个空军范围内向多用途和先进战斗机平台过渡，”空军在声明中说。

空军表示，例如 F-35 正在承担近距离空中支援和战斗搜救任务，利用其第五代隐身能力、先进传感器套件和安全数据共享网络，在争议环境中执行精确地面支援任务。

中队指挥官 Lt. Col. 里奇·弗利克（Ridge Flick）说，第66中队正在教导其他战斗机的飞行员如何承担“疣猪”的传统任务。他说，该部队还将继续训练战斗救援军官、伞降救援空军人员、特种战术军官和战斗控制员。

“通过让尽可能多的其他战斗机群体参与近距离空中支援任务，我们正在延续 A-10 的文化，”弗利克在声明中说。“我们还在训练 F-15 Eagle、F-35 Lightning II 和 F-16 Fighting Falcon 飞行员，以承担我们在战斗搜救中曾承担的一些角色。”

声明称，过去作为第757飞机维修中队“雷霆”飞机维修分队的一部分，在内利斯维修和保障 A-10 的空军人员，正被重新分配到其他中队以及 F-35 和 F-16 等机型。

“A-10 维护人员在 50 年里管理机体疲劳、更换机翼和进行基地级大修所养成的纪律，正被融入那些较新的外场项目，”空军说。

items.title: Air Force Bombers and Fighters Fly Over Chinese Leader’s DC Visit
items.author: Steve Losey
items.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping’s state visit to Washington D.C. has been filled with signs of American airpower: U.S. Air Force B-1 and B-2 bombers and F-22 fighters have all performed flyovers Sept. 23-24. The post Air Force Bombers and Fighters Fly Over Chinese Leader’s DC Visit appeared first on Air & Space Forces Magazine .
items.body:
Chinese President Xi Jinping’s state visit to Washington D.C. has been filled with signs of American airpower: U.S. Air Force B-1 and B-2 bombers and F-22 fighters have all performed flyovers Sept. 23-24.

Xi arrived at Joint Base Andrews, Md., on Sept. 23, and was greeted planeside by President Donald Trump—an unusual occurrence—and a military honor guard. The Presidential Salute Battery of the Army’s Old Guard, formally known as the 3rd Infantry Regiment, conducted a 21-gun salute as part of the arrival ceremony, and two B-1B Lancers roared overhead as the national anthem played.

A day later, a single B-2 Spirit, flanked by four F-22 Raptors, soared over the White House to cap a morning of military pomp and ceremony for Xi and his wife, Chinese First Lady Peng Liyuan.

This is Xi’s first state visit to the U.S. since 2015.

First Lady Melania Trump’s office released a statement Sept. 21 saying the welcoming event would feature 479 military personnel from all branches of the U.S. military.

As they arrived, Xi and his wife were met with a full military honor cordon along the White House’s South Drive, which led to a display of the flags of the U.S. and China. U.S. Army Herald Trumpets presented a fanfare for the Xis, and the Army Old Guard Fife and Drum Corps, the Marine Corps Silent Drill Platoon, and the United States Marine Drum and Bugle Corps—known as “The Commandant’s Own”—performed military demonstrations, before the B-2 and F-22 flyover.

Military flyovers are not unusual for state visits. A few months ago, four F-35s flew over the White House in honor of King Charles III’s state visit. But the presence of bombers is less routine and somewhat reminiscent of an August 2025 flyover of Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, Alaska, that featured a B-2 Spirit and four F-35s.

中国国家主席习近平（Xi Jinping）对华盛顿特区的国事访问处处可见美国空中力量的展示：9月23日至24日，美国空军B-1和B-2轰炸机以及F-22战斗机均进行了飞越。

习近平于9月23日抵达马里兰州安德鲁斯联合基地，在舷梯旁受到总统唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）——这一情形并不寻常——和一支军队仪仗队的迎接。陆军老卫队（正式名称为第3步兵团）的总统礼炮连在抵达仪式上鸣放21响礼炮，国歌奏响时，两架B-1B“枪骑兵”轰鸣着飞过头顶。

一天后，一架B-2“幽灵”在四架F-22“猛禽”的伴随下飞越白宫，为习近平及其夫人、中国第一夫人彭丽媛（Peng Liyuan）的上午军事盛典和仪式画上句号。

这是习近平自2015年以来首次对美国进行国事访问。

第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普（Melania Trump）的办公室9月21日发表声明称，欢迎活动将有来自美国军队各军种的479名军人参加。

他们抵达时，习近平和夫人在白宫南车道沿线受到军方完整荣誉警戒线迎接，南车道通向美中两国国旗展示区。美国陆军礼号队为习近平夫妇奏响号角，陆军老卫队笛鼓队、海军陆战队静默操枪排以及被称为“司令专属”的美国海军陆战队鼓号队进行了军事表演，之后是B-2和F-22的飞越。

国事访问中进行军事飞越并不罕见。几个月前，四架F-35曾为查尔斯三世国王（King Charles III）的国事访问飞越白宫。但轰炸机的出现则不那么常规，且在某种程度上让人想起2025年8月特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京（Vladimir Putin）在阿拉斯加埃尔门多夫-理查森联合基地观看的一次飞越，那次有一架B-2“幽灵”和四架F-35参加。

items.title: McChord Encourages Rider Mentorship Through Motorcycle Safety Program
items.author: SrA Benjamin Riddle
items.summary: The 62d Airlift Wing hosted a Department of the Air Force Rider Mentor Program trainer course at Heritage Hill on Joint Base Lewis-McChord, Washington, Sept. 8-9, 2026. The program supports the mandatory motorcycle training requirements of Level II training within one year of earning a Level I initial license and Level III refresher training every five years after. The program takes care to emphasize the decisions that affect rider safety the most.
items.body: The 62d Airlift Wing hosted a Department of the Air Force Rider Mentor Program trainer course at Heritage Hill on Joint Base Lewis-McChord, Washington, Sept. 8-9, 2026. Seven riders from multiple squadrons completed the course, including two members of the 142nd Wing, Oregon Air National Guard. The newly trained mentors will help expand local access to motorcycle safety training and assist experienced riders with mentoring others in their units. The program supports the mandatory motorcycle training requirements of Level II training within one year of earning a Level I initial license and Level III refresher training every five years after. The program takes care to emphasize the decisions that affect rider safety the most. “It comes down to what gets our guardians and our airmen injured, hurt, or killed,” said John McLaughlin, Air Force Safety Center deputy chief of traffic safety and outreach. “It’s the decision making, the behaviors that they’re using while they’re out on motorcycles.” McLaughlin highlighted how the program will be able to give units a more direct path to required training. “This training is a supplement to the current training and an alternative way of acquiring those skills across the DAF,” said McLaughlin. “This program will make it so here at JBLM, training can be done at the squadron level, and you don’t have to go all the way to the installation level to get training.” Before this new program, Air Force riders at JBLM would often need to coordinate through their motorcycle safety representatives, who would coordinate through wing safety who would then schedule training with the Army. The new mentor network will allow MSRs to provide instruction directly to the riders who need it. The course critically prepares mentors to lead discussions and practical exercises that reinforce riding fundamentals, sound judgment and risk management. The program also creates opportunities for riders to learn from one another’s experiences, said McLaughlin. “I can share stories to help others learn so they don’t have to go through some of the experiences I went through,” said McLaughlin. “That’s the main point of the program, current riders mentoring newer and older riders alike to all learn together.” Tech. Sgt. Corey Walrath, 62d Aircraft Maintenance Squadron squadron program manager, who helped bring McLaughlin to JBLM, said the local program gives the wing flexibility to meet increased demands for training. “With the rider mentor program, now Airmen can come to their MSRs or me for the 62d AMXS, and we can come up with a schedule that works for them right then and there,” said Walrath. “This will be able to quickly get them the training they need to stay safe on the roads.” Staff Sgt. Garrett Cofield, 62d Aerial Port Squadron passenger service supervisor, gave his thoughts on how the course reinforced the value of continuing to learn, regardless of experience level. “When I was doing the Level II, I thought I was a really good rider, I was a lot younger and I had a much bigger ego,” said Cofield. “I think coming to these trainings and learning the fundamentals and setting your ego aside is super important.” Ryan Meeks, 62d Airlift Wing occupational safety technician, took time to further highlight the critical nature of the program throughout the DAF. “Inexperienced riders are our primary concern as they account for 90% of the fatalities that the Airforce experiences,” said Meeks “Experienced riders can teach advanced riding techniques, but they also teach awareness, safety, temperament, and maturity factors. Having a trained and experienced rider mentor that you personally know or work with creates an environment of trust and familiarity that cannot be gained in a short class.” The continued growth of the program currently depends on experienced riders stepping forward to mentoring others and leading their unit is fundamental safety, said McLaughlin. If you are interested in becoming an MSR, rider mentor, or rider mentor instructor please contact the wing safety office today at 253-982-9999.
items.zhFull: 第62空运联队于2026年9月8日至9日在华盛顿州刘易斯-麦科德联合基地（JBLM）的Heritage Hill主办了空军部骑手导师计划教官培训课程。来自多个中队的7名骑手完成了课程，其中包括俄勒冈州空军国民警卫队第142联队的2名成员。新受训的导师将帮助扩大当地获得摩托车安全培训的渠道，并协助经验丰富的骑手指导其所在单位的其他人。该计划支持强制性摩托车培训要求，即在获得I级初始驾照后一年内完成II级培训，此后每五年进行一次III级复训。该计划注重强调对骑手安全影响最大的决策。“归根结底，问题在于是什么导致我们的守护者和空军人员受伤、受到伤害或丧生，”空军安全中心交通安全与外联副主任约翰·麦克劳克林（John McLaughlin）说。“是决策，是他们在骑摩托车时所采取的行为。”麦克劳克林强调，该计划将能够为单位提供更直接的所需培训途径。“这项培训是对现有培训的补充，也是在整个空军部获得这些技能的另一种途径，”麦克劳克林说。“该计划将使得在JBLM这里，培训可以在中队一级完成，你不必一路到基地层级去接受培训。”在这项新计划之前，JBLM的空军骑手通常需要通过他们的摩托车安全代表进行协调，而摩托车安全代表则要通过联队安全部门协调，后者再与陆军安排培训。新的导师网络将使MSR能够直接向需要培训的骑手提供指导。该课程至关重要地培养导师引导讨论和实操练习的能力，以强化骑行基本功、正确判断和风险管理。麦克劳克林说，该计划还为骑手创造了从彼此经验中学习的机会。“我可以分享故事来帮助他人学习，这样他们就不必经历我经历过的一些事情，”麦克劳克林说。“这就是该计划的主旨：现有骑手指导新老骑手，让大家共同学习。”Tech. Sgt. 科里·沃尔拉斯（Corey Walrath），第62飞机维修中队项目主管，曾帮助将麦克劳克林请到JBLM，他说，当地计划使该联队能够灵活满足日益增长的培训需求。“有了骑手导师计划，现在空军人员可以来找他们的MSR，或者来找我（第62飞机维修中队），我们可以当场制定适合他们的安排，”沃尔拉斯说。“这样就能迅速让他们获得在道路上保持安全所需的培训。”Staff Sgt. 加勒特·科菲尔德（Garrett Cofield），第62空中港口中队旅客服务主管，谈到了该课程如何强化了无论经验水平如何都应继续学习的价值。“我参加II级培训时，以为自己是一名非常优秀的骑手，那时我年轻得多，也自负得多，”科菲尔德说。“我认为参加这些培训、学习基本功并放下自负非常重要。”瑞安·米克斯（Ryan Meeks），第62空运联队职业安全技术员，特意进一步强调该计划在整个空军部的关键性质。“经验不足的骑手是我们的首要关切，因为他们占空军所经历死亡事故的90%，”米克斯说。“经验丰富的骑手可以教授高级骑行技术，但他们也传授意识、安全、性情和成熟度等方面的因素。拥有一名你个人认识或共事过的、训练有素且经验丰富的骑手导师，会营造出一种信任和熟悉的氛围，这是短期课程无法获得的。”麦克劳克林说，该计划的持续发展目前取决于经验丰富的骑手挺身而出去指导他人，并带领其单位做好基本安全。如果你有兴趣成为MSR、骑手导师或骑手导师教官，请立即致电253-982-9999联系联队安全办公室。

items.title: Guidance: Otterburn firing times
items.summary: Dates and times when Otterburn and Redesdale ranges and Bellshiel demolition range are being used for live firing.
items.body:
As seen in the Security Defence Review, the Army are at heightened readiness due to a new era of threat. This has placed greater demands on the Defence Training Estate across the UK, which is being used for training more regularly and at shorter notice.

As such, the firing time notifications published on Gov.UK have been standardised to show the daily timings for when live-firing is permitted on the UK DTE. This is a change from the previous method of showing when training bookings had been made in advance.

This to ensure safety of all users, as it is not possible to change Gov.UK notifications at short notice. Broadly, the only guaranteed safe times for access are before or after the firing times provided on this page, however there may be exceptional circumstances where extensions have been requested.

If you wish to use the DTE for recreation, please always refer to onsite safety warning signals to understand if the site is safe to access before doing so.

Danger - When warning signals are displayed, regardless of the timings, do not cross the range boundary.

Warning signals are red flags by day and red lamps by night; range boundaries are marked by red and white poles.

Red flags and red lamps indicate that live firing is taking place within the range boundaries.

Do not enter the danger area when in use, this could result in loss of life.

Do not touch any military debris, it may be dangerous. Please note the location and inform a Training Safety Officer (TSO) via 0191 239 4261 or the police.

Learn more about accessing MOD training areas

Public access to military areas - GOV.UK
items.zhFull:
正如《安全防务评估》所述，由于进入新的威胁时代，陆军处于高度战备状态。这对英国各地的国防训练场地提出了更高要求，这些场地正被更频繁且更短通知期内用于训练。

因此，发布在 Gov.UK 上的射击时间通知已标准化，以显示英国国防训练场地每日允许实弹射击的时间。这不同于以往显示提前预订训练时间的方法。

这样做是为了确保所有使用者的安全，因为无法在短时间内更改 Gov.UK 上的通知。总体而言，唯一有保障的安全进入时间是本页所列射击时间之前或之后，但在特殊情况下，可能会申请延长时间。

如果您希望将国防训练场地用于休闲活动，请务必先查看现场安全警告信号，以了解该场地是否可以安全进入。

危险——当显示警告信号时，无论时间如何，都不要越过靶场边界。

警告信号白天为红旗，夜间为红灯；靶场边界用红白相间的柱子标示。

红旗和红灯表示靶场边界内正在进行实弹射击。

危险区域在使用时切勿进入，否则可能导致人员死亡。

请勿触摸任何军事残骸，它们可能很危险。请记录位置，并拨打 0191 239 4261 通知训练安全官（TSO）或警方。

公众进入军事区域 - GOV.UK
zhParas: 正如《安全防务评估》所述，由于进入新的威胁时代，陆军处于高度战备状态。这对英国各地的国防训练场地提出了更高要求，这些场地正被更频繁且更短通知期内用于训练。
因此，发布在 Gov.UK 上的射击时间通知已标准化，以显示英国国防训练场地每日允许实弹射击的时间。这不同于以往显示提前预订训练时间的方法。
这样做是为了确保所有使用者的安全，因为无法在短时间内更改 Gov.UK 上的通知。总体而言，唯一有保障的安全进入时间是本页所列射击时间之前或之后，但在特殊情况下，可能会申请延长时间。
如果您希望将国防训练场地用于休闲活动，请务必先查看现场安全警告信号，以了解该场地是否可以安全进入。
危险——当显示警告信号时，无论时间如何，都不要越过靶场边界。

items.title: Italy taps state-owned firms to build two naval destroyers in $4.2 billion deal
items.author: Tom Kington
items.summary: Italy has signed to buy two new naval destroyers that will mark a quantum leap in capabilities for the Italian navy, the ships’ builders have promised.
items.body:
ROME — Italy has signed to buy two new naval destroyers that will mark a quantum leap in capabilities for the Italian navy, the ships’ builders have promised.

In a deal brokered by European procurement office OCCAR, Italy signed a €3.7 billion ($4.2 billion) for two so-called DDX destroyers for delivery in 2033 and 2035.

The deal was signed with Orizzonte Sistemi Navali (OSN), an Italian joint venture in which state shipyard Fincantieri holds 51% and state defense giant Leonardo has the remaining 49%. With a displacement of 13,500 tonnes, the 180-meter DDX destroyers will carry a crew of 251 and have a range of 4,000 nautical miles, Fincantieri said in a statement.

The combat system supplied by Leonardo will feature “advanced digitalization”, while the vessel will also include a “DC power sub-network with its associated energy storage system, an innovative stabilization system integrated with the steering system, new algorithms and methodologies for calculating thermal and electrical balances, and further digital developments of the Ship Management System,” the firms said.

The vessels will feature Leonardo’s SADOC 5 command-and-control system, digital S-band AESA radar and MBDA weapon systems, the firms added.

After ordering FREMM-class frigates, PPA multimission ships, a new landing helicopter dock, new submarines and logistics vessels, the DDX order marks the continuation of a fleet renewal splurge for the Italian navy.

The destroyers will sail alongside but ultimately replace the Italian navy’s two Horizon vessels, a navy spokesman told Defense News.

Tom Kington is the Italy correspondent for Defense News.
items.zhFull:
罗马——意大利已签署协议购买两艘新型海军驱逐舰，承建方承诺，这将是意大利海军作战能力的一次质的飞跃。

在欧洲采购机构 OCCAR 的斡旋下，意大利签署了一份价值 37 亿欧元（42 亿美元）的合同，购买两艘所谓的 DDX 驱逐舰，交付时间分别为 2033 年和 2035 年。

该合同与意大利合资企业 Orizzonte Sistemi Navali（OSN）签署，其中国有船厂 Fincantieri 持股 51%，国有防务巨头 Leonardo 持有其余 49% 的股份。Fincantieri 在一份声明中表示，DDX 驱逐舰长 180 米，排水量 13,500 吨，舰员编制 251 人，续航里程 4,000 海里。

两家公司表示，Leonardo 提供的作战系统将具备“先进的数字化”特征，该舰还将配备“直流电力子网及其配套储能系统、与操舵系统一体化的创新稳定系统、用于计算热平衡与电力平衡的新算法和新方法，以及舰船管理系统（Ship Management System）的进一步数字化开发”。

两家公司补充说，这些舰艇将配备 Leonardo 的 SADOC 5 指挥与控制系统、数字式 S 波段 AESA 雷达以及 MBDA 武器系统。

在订购 FREMM 级护卫舰、PPA 多任务舰艇、一艘新型直升机船坞登陆舰、新型潜艇和后勤舰船之后，这份 DDX 订单标志着意大利海军舰队更新的大规模采购仍在持续。

一名海军发言人向《防务新闻》（Defense News）表示，这些驱逐舰将与意大利海军现有的两艘“地平线”级舰艇一同服役，但最终将取而代之。

汤姆·金顿（Tom Kington）是《防务新闻》驻意大利记者。

items.title: US to provide critical but more limited capabilities to NATO, top commander says
items.author: Sabine Siebold, Reuters
items.summary: NATO’s top commander said on Thursday the United States would continue to provide “critical but more limited capabilities” to the alliance.
items.body:
NATO’s top commander said on Thursday the United States would continue to provide “critical but more limited capabilities” to the alliance as Europeans take up a greater role in defending the continent.

U.S. Air Force General Alexus Grynkewich, NATO’s Supreme Allied Commander Europe, was speaking in a phone interview with Reuters en route to a change of command ceremony at a NATO headquarters in Norfolk, Virginia, where a British army general will take over from a U.S. Navy vice admiral.

However, NATO recently announced that is stepping up intelligence-sharing in response to a wave of sabotage and other incidents apparently linked to Russia but should be “calm and confident” that it can handle any threat posed by Moscow, the alliance’s top commander told Reuters on Thursday.

The comments by US Air Force General Alexus Grynkewich came after Denmark’s defense intelligence service warned that Russia was likely to intensify a hybrid war — a term that covers a range of attacks below the level of a conventional military assault — against the West in the coming months.

The Danish service added there was “a low but growing risk” that Moscow might launch a limited military attack against one or several NATO countries that border Russia.

“It’s concerning,” Grynkewich, NATO’s Supreme Allied Commander Europe, said of a string of incidents in recent weeks including an attempted drone attack at Germany’s Leipzig/Halle Airport and a Russian ship firing flares towards a Danish military helicopter.

“But we should be calm and confident that we as an alliance, the most powerful alliance in history, have the tools that we need and have the mechanisms that we need in order to manage the risk here,” he added.

Moscow has repeatedly denied any involvement in hybrid warfare or sabotage operations in NATO countries, or plotting any confrontation.

PUTIN BETTER NOT TRY ATTACK ‘ON MY WATCH’, GENERAL SAYS

Grynkewich was speaking in a phone interview with Reuters en route to a change-of-command ceremony at a NATO headquarters in Norfolk, Virginia, where a British army general is taking over from a US Navy vice admiral.

Asked about the risk of a limited Russian attack on NATO territory, Grynkewich stressed the alliance’s readiness for any such contingency, saying such a development was “unlikely but something that we can’t rule out”.

Grynkewich dismissed suggestions that Russian President Vladimir Putin might see an opportunity to strike at NATO, given that the US has used up much of its global stockpile of highly accurate long-range missiles in the war with Iran, according to people familiar with the data.

“Absolutely not. He better not try it on my watch,” he said, adding NATO was well positioned to defend every inch of its territory.

“If we proceed from the phase we’re in and we start to see emerging threats, I’m confident that I have the authorities now that I need in order to take actions to deter any aggression against the alliance.”

NATO IN MIDST OF CHANGE AS EUROPEANS TAKE GREATER ROLE

The handover of Norfolk to a European commander is part of a broader reshuffle in keeping with US President Donald Trump’s demands that European nations take more responsibility for their own security. It will also see a European taking charge of NATO’s Joint Force Command in Naples.

NATO’s Joint Force Command Norfolk is responsible for operations in the Arctic and northern Europe as well as protecting transatlantic resupply routes.

Attempting to reassure European allies concerned about an ongoing review of US forces on the continent, Grynkewich said Washington would continue “to provide critical but more limited capabilities” to NATO as Europeans took on a greater role.

He said there was “no predetermined outcome” in terms of how many US troops would remain in Europe and “what the capabilities are that might relocate”. About 80,000 US troops are currently based on the continent.

Trump has repeatedly threatened to leave NATO, which has been dominated by the US since its establishment in 1949, accusing Europeans of being free-riders on security.

北约最高指挥官周四表示，随着欧洲人在保卫欧洲大陆方面承担更大角色，美国将继续向该联盟提供“关键但更有限的能力”。

美国空军上将阿莱克瑟斯·格林凯维奇（Alexus Grynkewich）是北约欧洲盟军最高司令，他在前往弗吉尼亚州诺福克一处北约总部参加指挥权交接仪式途中接受路透社电话采访时作出上述表示。在那里，一名英国陆军将领将接替一名美国海军中将。

不过，北约最近宣布正在加强情报共享，以应对一波显然与俄罗斯有关的破坏和其他事件，但应当“冷静而自信”地认为能够应对莫斯科构成的任何威胁，北约最高指挥官周四对路透社表示。

美国空军上将阿莱克瑟斯·格林凯维奇的上述评论，是在丹麦国防情报局警告俄罗斯可能在未来数月加大对西方发动混合战争之后作出的——该术语涵盖一系列低于常规军事攻击门槛的攻击。

丹麦该机构还表示，莫斯科可能对一个或多个与俄罗斯接壤的北约国家发动有限军事攻击，这一风险“虽低但正在上升”。

“这令人担忧，”北约欧洲盟军最高司令格林凯维奇在谈到最近数周发生的一系列事件时说，其中包括德国莱比锡/哈勒机场发生的一起未遂无人机袭击，以及一艘俄罗斯舰船向一架丹麦军用直升机发射信号弹。

“但我们应该冷静而自信，作为史上最强大的联盟，我们拥有所需的工具，也拥有所需的机制，以便管控这里的风险，”他补充说。

莫斯科多次否认参与北约国家的混合战争或破坏行动，也否认策划任何对抗。

将军称，普京（Putin）最好别想“在我任内”发动攻击

格林凯维奇（Grynkewich）是在前往弗吉尼亚州诺福克一个北约总部参加指挥权交接仪式途中接受路透社电话采访时说这番话的。仪式上，一名英国陆军上将将接替一名美国海军中将。

当被问及俄罗斯对北约领土发动有限攻击的风险时，格林凯维奇强调，北约已做好应对任何此类突发情况的战备，称这一事态发展“不太可能，但也不能排除”。

格林凯维奇驳斥了有关俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京（Vladimir Putin）可能看到打击北约机会的说法，因为据熟悉相关数据的人士称，美国在与伊朗的战争中已消耗掉其全球高精度远程导弹库存的大部分。

“绝对不会。他最好别想在我任内尝试，”他说，并补充称北约完全有能力保卫其每一寸领土。

“如果我们从当前所处阶段出发，并开始看到新出现的威胁，我有信心，我现在已拥有所需的授权，可以采取行动威慑针对北约的任何侵略。”

随着欧洲人发挥更大作用，北约正处于变革之中

将诺福克移交给一名欧洲指挥官，是更广泛人事调整的一部分，此举符合美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）要求欧洲国家为自己的安全承担更多责任的主张。这也将意味着由一名欧洲人执掌北约那不勒斯联合部队司令部。

北约诺福克联合部队司令部负责北极和北欧地区的行动，以及保护跨大西洋补给路线。

格林凯维奇（Grynkewich）试图安抚对正在进行的驻欧美军审查感到担忧的欧洲盟友。他表示，随着欧洲人承担更大角色，华盛顿将继续向北约“提供关键但更为有限的能力”。

他说，就多少美军将留在欧洲以及“哪些能力可能转移”而言，没有“预先确定的结果”。目前约有8万美军驻扎在欧洲大陆。

特朗普多次威胁要退出北约，并指责欧洲人在安全上搭便车。北约自1949年成立以来一直由美国主导。

Straight Point Ranges and Woodbury Common Grenade Range firing times

Firing times for Straight Point Ranges Complex (SPRC) and Woodbury Common Training Area (WCTA) Grenade Range.

Ministry of Defence

27 September 2016

24 September 2026 — See all updates

Straight Point Ranges and Woodbury Common Grenade Range firing times September 2026

Straight Point Ranges and Woodbury Common Grenade Range firing times October 2026

Do not enter the danger area when the range is in use, this is a danger to life. Learn more about accessing MOD training areas safely .

Usual firing times for Straight Point Ranges Complex ( SPRC )

Weekdays: 9am to 4pm (may be extended) Evenings: from 30 mins before dusk until 11:45pm Weekends: 9am to 12:30pm

Weekdays and weekends: 9am to 4pm (may be extended) Evenings: from 30 mins before dusk until 9:30pm

Safe access to MOD training areas

The Defence Training Estate: DTE South West

items.body:
Langport Range and dry training area firing notice

Firing schedule for Langport Range and dry training area (LRDTA).

Ministry of Defence and Defence Infrastructure Organisation

5 October 2017

24 September 2026 — See all updates

Langport Range and dry training area firing notice October 2026

Langport Range and dry training area firing notice September 2026

Langport range involves live firing with rifles.

Dry military training at Breech Wood involves blank ammunition, pyrotechnics, vehicles and helicopters.

Do not enter the danger area when the range is in use, this is a danger to life. Learn more about accessing MOD training areas safely .

Public access to military areas All UK firing times

items.body:
Military court centres court listings

Court listings for the military court centres.

Ministry of Defence

6 January 2012

24 September 2026 — See all updates

Military Court Centre Listings 25 September to 9 October 2026

PDF , 118 KB , 4 pages

In line with the government’s transparency and open data initiative, the Military Court Service is to publish the court listings for the military court centres.

Each court listing covers the next one or two week assize period. This will be published on the internet by the last working day in advance of the assize period.

In addition to this, the court listings are published using digital signage technology within the reception areas of both military court centres.

Please be aware that the court listings are subject to change after publication, if you wish to find out more please contact the relevant military court centre. Details can be found at the bottom of each court listing.

Military Court Service

军事法院中心开庭排期 2026年9月25日至10月9日

PDF，118 KB，4 页

根据政府透明和开放数据倡议，军事法院服务局将发布军事法院中心的开庭排期。

每份法院庭审安排涵盖下一个为期一至两周的开庭期。该安排将在开庭期开始前的最后一个工作日通过互联网发布。

此外，庭审安排还通过数字标牌技术在两个军事法院中心的接待区域发布。

请注意，庭审安排在发布后可能会变更。如需了解更多信息，请联系相关军事法院中心。详情可在每份庭审安排底部找到。
